units.source_text: 谁也不会反对打破偶像。

en.t: No one would object to smashing idols.

units.source_text: 同时谁也不会反对成为偶像。

en.t: At the same time, no one would object to becoming an idol.

units.source_text: 然而能够安稳坐在偶像台上的都是神宠儿——傻子、坏蛋或英雄。

en.t: Yet those who can sit securely on an idol's pedestal are all favorites of the gods: fools, villains, or heroes.
